card.name: Just before the word "associated"
card.fires_on: The piece right before "associated" or "association" is completed, such as "ASS" before "OCIATED" in all-caps warning titles or a hyphen before "Associated". Also the word before "Association" in group names.

modes.label: Warning titles
modes.description: The start of ASSOCIATED, or a hyphen before it, in capitalized boxed warning headings.

modes.label: Hyphen before Associated
modes.description: A hyphen or "-a" leading into "associated" in disease names like ventilator-associated pneumonia.
modes.example: 5.1 Increased Mortality with Unapproved Use in Ventilator<<->>Associated Bacterial Pneumonia Patients

modes.label: Organization names
modes.description: The last word before "Association" in names of societies.
modes.example: American Public<< Health>> Association, American Water Works Association,

card.writes: It suppresses "assoc" word forms, since the model is about to produce them, and promotes unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is almost certainly "associated" or "association", as in "risks associated with" or "American Heart Association".
